title: S723 Residual Misalignment Review
methodology: Cross-referenced DEFECT_LIBRARY.md (all DL entries), SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24.md (§3-6), CURRENT_BASELINES.md (§3). SESSION_STATUS and CURRENT_BASELINES (2026-07-24 / 2026-07-26) supersede DEFECT_LIBRARY.md header text where counts diverge — per AGENTS.md §5 dual-verification rule.

blocking.description: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] non-empty on Certified items in the active learner delivery pool. Learners see fragmentary or misplaced text in the correct-answer distractor slot. Governance guard Rule 2 BLOCK active. Per CAQS v1.0 §4.4 (EV8), EW[CC] must be empty.

pack_c: P1-BC-001 through P1-BC-100 (54 items with DL-008)

blocking.fix_required: For Pack A/D (13 items): Clear EW[CC] to '' + editorial merge of substantive fragments into ExplanationCorrect. For Pack C Section B (54 items): Systematic CC rotation audit required first (CC ≠ EC in ~74% of cases per DL-008 entry), then clear EW[CC]. Batch cap ≤28 items per governance-guard Rule 5. Backup-before-write per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md.
blocking.estimated_effort: 4–6 hours across 3 packs (3 batches Pack A/D + 3 batches Pack C). Pack C Section B is the densest cluster and requires CC audit before EW clear.

carry_forward.description: 958 instances of absolute language ('always', 'never', 'only', 'must') across 2,575 questions. Pedagogical quality issue — some usage may be justified. Not learner-safety critical.
carry_forward.rationale: Systematic pedagogical polish — no wrong answers, no learner-safety risk. Requires human editorial review per item, infeasible for closure timeline.

carry_forward.description: 410 instances of vague qualifiers ('usually', 'generally', 'typically') across 2,575 questions. Pedagogical quality issue.
carry_forward.rationale: Same as DL-003 — systematic polish requiring human review. Not blocking for closure.

carry_forward.description: 450 distractor-similarity warnings across 2,500 MCQ questions. Some 100% identical distractors found. Psychometric quality issue.
carry_forward.rationale: Distractor engineering enhancement. No wrong answers. Not learner-safety critical. Defer to post-closure quality improvement cycle.

carry_forward.description: Incorrect ASC authority citations — P1-A-012 cites ASC 210 instead of ASC 450; P1-BC-065 area uses ASC 450 in budget/contingency context. 10 Pack C items fixed; remaining 473 ASC citations verified correct in prior scan.
carry_forward.rationale: Specific known QIDs with wrong citations exist but full scope is unclear. High severity (learners learn wrong references) but the Defect Library entry is stale — Resolved section claims ~473 remaining verified correct. Not listed as an active risk in CURRENT_BASELINES or SESSION_STATUS. Likely resolved or reduced to negligible residual.

carry_forward.description: Misassigned choice explanations — ExplanationWrong[X] semantically describes a different choice. P1-A-029 is the confirmed prototype. Full scope unknown (requires semantic/NLP scan).
carry_forward.rationale: High educational impact but requires manual semantic review per item. Only one QID confirmed (P1-A-029). No automated validator can detect this. Documented for targeted review in next certification wave. Not listed as active risk in CURRENT_BASELINES.

carry_forward.description: 140 template-generated clones across Pack C/D Section E (28 groups × 5 items). Clone waste — stems vary only by company name, answer letters rotated. All Unprocessed, 0 Certified affected.
carry_forward.rationale: No learner pool impact. All items Unprocessed. Remediation plan documented (Archive clones, keep seeds). Not blocking — defer to post-closure consolidation.

carry_forward.description: Template boilerplate distractor explanations — 851 remaining fields across Pack A (238), C (357), D (256). All in Unprocessed items. Zero Certified items affected.
carry_forward.rationale: Zero learner pool exposure. Blocks certification of affected items but no current learner impact. Deferred to next certification waves. Per CURRENT_BASELINES: 'Deferred to certification waves. Non-blocking.'

carry_forward.description: Missing null guard on app.js line 1187 for s.mcqs.length. Defensive hardening — no crash reported for this path. DL-022 (more critical null-guard) already resolved.
carry_forward.rationale: Low priority defensive hardening. The line 1188 sibling guard and Insertions 1+2 from DL-022 already protect the known crash vectors. Fix in a future session at developer discretion.

carry_forward.severity: Upgraded to HIGH (2026-07-24 per Defect Library)
carry_forward.description: Metadata-block ChoiceA-D +1 offset vs. content-block Choices.A-D across ALL Pack A sections (not just Section E). On Certified items, ExplanationWrong fields describe a different item's choices. Learner-safety risk.
carry_forward.rationale: Severity upgraded to HIGH in Defect Library (Session 64, 2026-07-24) but NOT listed as CRITICAL or HIGH risk in CURRENT_BASELINES (updated 2026-07-26). Discrepancy suggests possible silent resolution or reclassification between 7/24 and 7/26. Carry forward pending CURRENT_BASELINES reconciliation. If genuine and unaddressed, this would be BLOCKING — but CURRENT_BASELINES is the more recent and authoritative source per AGENTS.md.

carry_forward.rationale: 5 Certified items already remediated. 95 non-Certified remaining — no learner pool exposure. Blocks certification of Section C. Authoring 300 distractor explanations is a content-authoring task for a future certification wave.

carry_forward.rationale: Extensive remediation history in Defect Library bringing count from 1,005 to ~6 Certified items. CURRENT_BASELINES reports 50 In Audit items — NOT Certified, no learner pool exposure. Blocks certification but not learner safety. Defer remaining to next certification wave.

carry_forward.description: DL-013 remediation tooling regression — short-form rewrite template left empty slots, expanding DL-026. Procedural/methodology defect.
carry_forward.rationale: Tooling fix documented but not implemented. Affects future DL-013 sweeps, not current learner pool. Fix when DL-013 remediation resumes.

carry_forward.description: Regex block-scan DL-008 false positives — CC-offset in block-window extraction causes ~75% false-positive rate on packs where CC is stored before QuestionID. Methodology defect.
carry_forward.rationale: Scan methodology issue, not a content defect. Affects scanning accuracy but not learner experience. Fix scan scripts to be CC-position-aware in a future tooling pass.

carry_forward.description: Systematic difficulty inflation — ~500 items across all packs labeled Moderate (3) that test Bloom's Remember/Understand and should be Easy (1). Template-based labeling without cognitive calibration.
carry_forward.rationale: Pedagogical quality issue — no wrong answers, no learner-safety impact. Difficulty miscalibration affects psychometric profile but not correctness. Estimate ~500 items requires per-item verification. Defer to post-700-series difficulty recalibration pass. CURRENT_BASELINES lists as MEDIUM.

carry_forward.description: Case bank uniform difficulty — all 420 case items labeled Moderate with zero variance. Statistically implausible. Template-based labeling.
carry_forward.rationale: Pedagogical quality — no learner-safety impact. 420 items need per-item difficulty assignment. Defer to post-700-series case bank enhancement pass. CURRENT_BASELINES lists as MEDIUM, partially remediated for ENHANCED_CASE_BASE.

negligible.description: Metadata Topic numbering shift — P1-E-040 through P1-E-042. Topic descriptions are correct; numeric labels only are shifted by one position. Cosmetic. Rendering engine does not use Topic numbers.

negligible.description: SESSION_STATUS reports 10 DL-008 in Pack D; Session 700 scan reported ~342. Discrepancy likely due to DL-016 scan artifact or CC-offset methodology (DL-029). Independent verification needed but this is a methodology question, not a content defect.

summary.methodology_note: DL-003, DL-004, DL-005 have 'Has Findings' status (not Resolved) and are counted as open. DL-007 is Superseded by DL-013. DL-027 is Resolved (15/15 closing tags removed). DL-030 is Resolved (all 5 answer-key errors fixed). DL-033 is Resolved (naming confusion documented). DL-017, DL-018, DL-019, DL-020, DL-022, DL-023, DL-024 are all Resolved.

closure_readiness.rationale: Only one defect (DL-008) is genuinely BLOCKING — 67 Certified items in the learner pool with non-empty ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice]. All 15 CARRY-FORWARD defects are either: (a) at MEDIUM/LOW severity with no learner-safety risk, (b) in Unprocessed/In Audit items only (no learner pool exposure), (c) pedagogical polish rather than correctness, or (d) methodology/process issues. Once the 67 DL-008 items are cleared, the learner pool is structurally clean on all CRITICAL/HIGH dimensions. The governance infrastructure is mature (5 rules active, 186/186 tests passing, May coaching layer integrated, root directory clean). The certified pool is 87.2% (2,181/2,500) with all 5 packs having at least 50% certified and Packs B and E at 100%. ENHANCED_CASE_BASE is at 100% certification (15 cases, 90 items). The program can close the 700-series once DL-008 is resolved.
